name: Electric Guitar
shortDescription: Solid-body guitar converting string vibration into electromagnetic signal via magnetic pickups.
description: The electric guitar replaces acoustic resonance with electromagnetic induction. Magnetised pickups sense string vibration as fluctuating magnetic flux, inducing a voltage that feeds an amplifier. The solid mahogany body contributes sustain through mass; tone controls shape the harmonic content before amplification.
historicalOrigins: Developed in the 1930s–1950s by Leo Fender and Les Paul to overcome feedback problems in big-band settings. The Fender Telecaster (1950) and Gibson Les Paul (1952) defined the archetype.
acousticPrinciples: Faraday's law of induction: changing flux in pickup coil induces EMF proportional to rate of change
String vibration near a magnet creates oscillating magnetic field variations sensed by the coil
Tone/volume potentiometers act as RC low-pass filters shaping harmonic content
Solid body sustains longer — no Helmholtz cavity losses

characteristics.timbralColor: Bright, cutting, harmonically dense; distortion adds upper partials
characteristics.orchestralRole: Lead melodic voice, power chords, sustain layers

soundDNA.exciter: Plectrum or finger plucking magnetised steel string
soundDNA.resonator: Magnetic pickup coil + solid mahogany body mass
soundDNA.harmonics: Strong high-order partials; distortion saturates even harmonics
soundDNA.attackDecay: Fast attack (~2ms pickup response), long sustain with solid body

body.label: Solid Body
body.function: Provides string anchor and sustain mass. Wood density determines resonance character.

pickups.label: Humbucking Pickups
pickups.function: Electromagnetic transducers sensing string vibration via Faraday induction.

characteristics.material: Alnico V magnets, 42 AWG copper coil windings

bridge.label: Tune-O-Matic Bridge
bridge.function: Anchors strings and allows individual intonation adjustment per string.

neck.label: Neck & Headstock
neck.function: Supports strings over the fretboard. Headstock holds machine heads for tuning.

fretboard.label: Rosewood Fretboard
fretboard.function: 22 frets dividing string length into precise semitone intervals.

strings.label: Electric Strings
strings.function: Ferromagnetic strings vibrate within pickup magnetic field to generate varying flux.

characteristics.material: Nickel-plated steel wound over hexagonal steel core
characteristics.mechanism: Transverse standing waves in ferromagnetic medium

knobs.label: Volume & Tone Controls
knobs.function: Potentiometers forming RC filters that roll off high frequencies and adjust level.

output_jack.label: Output Jack
output_jack.function: 1/4" mono TS jack connecting guitar signal to amplifier.

followTheSound.title: String Vibration
followTheSound.explanation: Plucked ferromagnetic string vibrates near the pickup's magnetic field.

followTheSound.title: Electromagnetic Induction
followTheSound.explanation: Oscillating string modulates magnetic flux, inducing AC voltage (Faraday's law).

followTheSound.title: Tone Shaping
followTheSound.explanation: RC filter network attenuates unwanted high-frequency content.

followTheSound.title: Amplifier Interface
followTheSound.explanation: Signal exits via 1/4" jack to guitar amplifier for power amplification.
